title: Beyond aggregate scores: Deployment-aware and non-compensatory benchmarking of vision-based eye-state recognition models for driver monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2606.08123v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model selection for safety-relevant visual recognition is often based on clean aggregate performance, although robustness, transfer, embedded latency, and explanation faithfulness may produce different preferences. This study presents a Human-Centered Benchmarking Framework (HCBF) that separates multidimensional evidence from non-compensatory operational eligibility. Six compact convolutional and transformer-oriented eye-state recognition models were evaluated using a subject-disjoint MRL Eye protocol, deterministic image corruptions, zero-shot transfer and participant-safe target-domain training with out-of-fold evaluation on RT-BENE, TensorRT FP32 inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano, and black-box RISE faithfulness. Clean MRL Macro-F1 ranged from 0.9566 to 0.9794, whereas zero-shot RT-BENE Macro-F1 ranged from 0.2066 to 0.7771. translated_title: 超越总体评分：面向驾驶员监控的基于视觉的眼睛状态识别模型的部署感知与非补偿性基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.08123v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：安全相关的视觉识别模型选择通常基于干净的总体性能，尽管鲁棒性、迁移性、嵌入式延迟和解释忠实度可能会产生不同的偏好。本研究提出了一个人本中心基准测试框架（HCBF），将多维证据与非补偿性操作资格分离。使用主题不重叠的MRL Eye协议、确定性图像损坏、零样本迁移和参与者安全的目标域训练及折外评估（在RT-BENE上）、NVIDIA Jetson Nano上的TensorRT FP32推理以及黑盒RISE忠实度，评估了六个紧凑型卷积和变换器导向的眼睛状态识别模型。干净的MRL Macro-F1范围为0.9566至0.9794，而零样本RT-BENE Macro-F1范围为0.2066至0.7771。匹配的目标域效应变化从-0.0406到0.4807，并重新分配了两个方向性错误。
tldr: 本文提出了一个部署感知且非补偿性的基准测试框架，证明仅凭总体分数不足以选择安全相关的驾驶员监控眼睛状态识别模型，需结合鲁棒性、迁移性和解释忠实度等多维证据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a deployment-aware and non-compensatory benchmarking framework, showing that aggregate scores alone are insufficient for selecting safety-critical eye-state recognition models for driver monitoring, requiring multidimensional evidence like robustness, transfer, and explanation faithfulness.
